title: Nutty Peruvian Quinoa Bowl
description: This nutty, silky brunch dish is a macrobiotic-friendly twist on traditional Peruvian cuisine, featuring the combination of roasted sweet potatoes, succulent amaranth, and a tangy citrus vinaigrette.
instructions: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes, tossing them with 2 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the sweet potatoes in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly caramelized.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, cook the quinoa according to the package instructions.
In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat. Add the amaranth and cook, stirring frequently, until the grains are lightly toasted and fragrant.
In a blender or food processor, combine the orange juice, apple cider vinegar, and maple syrup. Blend until smooth and emulsified.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked quinoa between four bowls, topping each with roasted sweet potatoes, toasted amaranth, and a drizzle of the citrus vinaigrette.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
